_comment: EXAMPLE settings snippet from the Episode 10 suite. Fictional agency. Three parts: (1) the job model pinned by its FULL name, (2) the alias env block so 'haiku' / 'sonnet' cannot silently move to a later model, (3) the named-tool allow list for the booking case (06-noshow-cleanup): the four Noor booking tools by full name, no wildcard. On the eval machine part 3 lives in the managed policy (eval-machine/managed-settings.eval.json, allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly), because per-project allow rules are ignored there. Remove this _comment key before use if your tooling rejects unknown keys.
